meta.purpose: Routing A/B: given a natural-language session moment, does the model pick the intended skill from the 12 descriptions alone (no body)? Wrong-skill routing wastes context or skips the right contract.
meta.ground_truth_source: skills/*/SKILL.md frontmatter descriptions after the 2026-09-14 disambiguation (bug-bounty/bb-methodology mutual boundary, signing lane added to web2-vuln-classes, preflight HOW-leak removed from credential-attack)
meta.scoring: expected skill exact match = 1pt; every distractor listed must NOT be picked (its presence tests a known confusion pair); per case max 1pt, distractor hit is a hard fail for that case

cases.moment: Recon finished an hour ago; three endpoints have odd responses and I don't know which one to dig into first.
cases.why: Active hunting lane, hypothesis-priority question — not cross-stage coordination.

cases.moment: The hunt is validated and written; now decide whether to run reporting or a new recon pass on the next asset.
cases.why: Stage-to-stage transition (validate -> report/recon), the coordinator's exact trigger.

cases.moment: A GraphQL endpoint appeared in the crawl output; introspection is on and I want the lane's evidence gates.
cases.why: Evidence names a bug-class lane; validation is premature, recon already produced this evidence.

cases.moment: I have a candidate: SSRF with an internal service response. Before any report claim I need the seven questions.
cases.why: Candidate-quality validation gate; report-writing requires validation passed first.

cases.moment: Validation passed with CVSS 8.1; draft the HackerOne submission from the finding and evidence ledger.
cases.why: Post-validation delivery rendering is report-writing's only trigger.

cases.moment: Every request to the API returns 403 because of a sign/hmac header the browser computes; I need to replay them.
cases.why: Client signing lane (2026-09-14 addition); web target, not a mobile artifact; arsenal is reference-only.

cases.moment: New target, nothing known yet: find subdomains, live hosts, and the URL surface.
cases.why: Attack-surface discovery is web2-recon's entry; the coordinator and methodology trigger only when a stage-choice or hypothesis question exists.

cases.moment: The target's public GitHub org has Actions workflows that reference secrets in run blocks.
cases.why: Explicit CI/CD asset in scope — the direct-only trigger.

cases.moment: The APK in scope talks to an API the web app never exposes; compare auth behavior between the two clients.
cases.why: Mobile artifact in scope with client-boundary question; hands off to web2 lanes after the differential is captured.

cases.moment: The login form accepts a known employee email; plan a bounded credential review with a lockout plan.
cases.why: Real login form + bounded review warrant — preparation-only lane.

cases.moment: I don't know which owner accepts a validation-runner result or how dependent steps keep the session.
cases.why: Shared project contract lookup — its reference-only trigger.

cases.moment: A Solidity vault upgrade split the accounting across two implementations; review the invariant before recommending.
cases.why: Smart-contract target in scope with an invariant question.
